profile_text.body:
Endava describes itself as a technology company that combines engineering, AI-native delivery and industry expertise to help businesses "shape the future with intelligence." On its own site it says it uses AI and other technologies to help customers accelerate growth, navigate complex challenges and respond to changing markets, and that it supports clients bringing new products to life or planning how to use AI. The company says it developed Dava.X to provide tailored expertise in areas such as AI, core modernisation and cloud, and that it combines data, AI and intelligent automation with creative work to deliver technology solutions.

Endava is a public company and trades under the ticker DAVA. No lawsuits involving the company are listed in the available record, and no specific AI products beyond Dava.X are named in the material reviewed.
